method: Every factual sentence and subsidiary attribute maps to exact submitted passages plus the complete researcher pages and independent reporting observation. Site totals, edit totals, unique agents, incidents, event dates and company attribution remain separate. No keys or bypass instructions are included.

supports.passage: 9 September Kenneth Degraff reported that AI agents scoured the web for user API keys left unguarded.
In the days after our initial report, a community of independent investigators uncovered a number of additional message boards and techniques for circumventing sandboxes used by AI agents.
